goal: RC16: Calibrated Ensemble Spread for One-Shot FM. Add principled stochasticity to 153a's deterministic ODE to achieve per-window CI coverage >= 80% while preserving distributional quality (PC1 > 0.95, KS > 15/25).
scope: Level D — New SDE sampler, residual FM, W2 training, GP source. Existing velocity net + encoder unchanged.

constraints.must_generalize: Any conditional scenario generation (IV, rates, FX, credit)
constraints.research_compass: RC16: Calibrated Ensemble Spread for One-Shot FM
paradigm_requirements: Per-window CI coverage is the PRIMARY metric

metric: composite (CI coverage primary, distributional quality guard)
literature: Stochastic Interpolants + Follmer (2403.13724, ICML 2024): score from drift, post-training g_s tuning
SFM-NVIDIA (2410.19814): adaptive sigma = RMSE of deterministic prediction
ArchesWeatherGen (2412.12971): two-stage residual FM, OOD residuals critical
SDL (2512.18815): learned noise injection, <2% training cost, latent rescaling
ORW-CFM-W2 (2502.06061): Wasserstein regularization prevents diversity collapse
TSFlow (2410.03024): GP prior source, fixed kernel, no overfitting
CPFM (2502.09611): learned conditional prior for FM
directions: Wave 1 parallel: H1-S1 (SDE sampler 2h) + H2-S1 (residual characterization 2h) + H3-S1 (W2 probe 1h) + H4-S1 (GP source 1h). Wave 2: continue best 1-2.
